name: Mexican Salad
description: A hearty and flavorful salad with kidney beans, lentils, and low-fat cheese, topped with salsa and served with taco chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup low-fat cheese (mozzarella or cheddar or combination)

recipeInstructions.text: Combine kidney beans, lentils, diced tomato, shredded lettuce, chopped green pepper, low-fat cheese, and green onions in a large bowl.
Toss the salad with Catalina dressing until well coated.
Top the salad with salsa.
Serve immediately with taco chips on the side.

keywords: Mexican salad, bean salad, taco chips

_similar.name: Taco Salad
_similar.description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, crunchy taco chips, and cheddar cheese, all tossed in Catalina dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook ground beef until crumbly, drain off fat, and season with taco seasoning mix.
Refrigerate the cooked beef until ready to use.
Toss together the cooled beef, chopped lettuce, crushed taco chips, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix in Catalina dressing until well coated.
Carefully add in chopped tomato.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: taco salad, ground beef, taco chips, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Nacho Dip
_similar.description: A creamy and flavorful dip made with cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning, topped with salsa, cheese, and chopped vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning mix until smooth.
Spread the mixture in a large glass pan.
Spread salsa sauce over the cream cheese layer.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the salsa layer.
Add chopped red pepper, green pepper, and tomato on top.
Serve with baked nacho chips.

_similar.keywords: nacho dip, creamy dip, taco seasoning, salsa dip

_similar.name: Taco Salad
_similar.description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, mixed greens, and crunchy corn chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ to ¾ small bottle Catalina dressing

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground hamburger in a frying pan with chopped mushrooms.
Add taco seasoning mix and a little water. Continue cooking until the mixture thickens.
In a large bowl, combine the premixed salad, sliced green pepper, and red onion.
When ready to serve, add the hamburger mixture, crushed corn chips, and Catalina dressing to the salad.
Toss everything together and serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: taco salad, Mexican salad, ground beef salad

_similar.name: Mexican Fudge
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy baked appetizer served on Triscuits.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup taco or salsa sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Grease a 9×11 in pan and spread the cheddar cheese evenly on the bottom.
Lightly beat the eggs and mix with taco or salsa sauce.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheddar cheese.
Top with the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Cut into squares while warm and serve on Triscuits.

_similar.keywords: Mexican fudge, baked cheese dip, salsa appetizer, cheesy squares
